name: pause
description: The user said wait or pause. Pause the practice.

name: resume
description: The user said to start again. Resume the practice.

name: hint
description: The user asked for a hint. Give one line of hint after calling this.

name: what_in_english
description: The user asked how to say something in English.

name: next_question
description: The user asked for the next question on the same topic.

name: switch_topic
description: The user asked for another topic. The response has the new topic and, if any, the question to ask first.

name: stop
description: The user wants to end the practice now.

name: ask_question
description: Record a main question you asked, or the same question asked again.

name: clarify
description: You asked what the user meant because you did not understand or it could mean two things.

name: flag_broken
description: The user's paragraph fell apart or their tenses broke down on the current question.

name: judge_card
description: Judge the user's answer to a review card.

card_id.description: The card id from the review card list.

result.description: correct, wrong, or unknown if the user said they do not know.

name: save_expression
description: Save an English expression the user did not know as a card.

said.description: The user's sentence exactly as they said it, Korean included.

better.description: The short English expression you gave.

meaning.description: A short Korean meaning of the expression.

context.description: One short Korean line about the situation.
